title: Capstone: honest CS slow-state signal (synthetic)

hypothesis.name: slow_momentum_cs_v1
hypothesis.claim: Cross-sectional ranks of a slow mean-reverting state (lagged 1 day) weakly predict next-day residual returns.
hypothesis.null: H0: mean daily CS RankIC of lagged slow vs fwd1 = 0 after costs and multiple testing.
hypothesis.pit_rule: Feature at t uses only information known by close t (slow.shift(1)); as-of alt foil uses lag=2.
hypothesis.decision_rule: Keep candidate only if sealed OOS mean CS RankIC > 0 AND DSR(N=all_trials) on the SAME net series used for the decision.
hypothesis.not_advice: Learning exercise on synthetic data — not investment advice.

limitations: Synthetic DGP — numbers are teaching foils, not market evidence.
Weak planted alpha; after shared costs net SR often fails DSR.
Optional frontier appendix must not reopen sealed OOS.
